content.short: Lithuania's CoinGate helps businesses accept crypto and settle in euros or stablecoins, under a MiCA licence and since 2014.
content.description: CoinGate lets online shops and service businesses take payments in Bitcoin, USDC and other cryptocurrencies, then settle in euros or stablecoins. Merchants can use hosted checkout pages, e-commerce plugins, payment links or the API. Individuals can buy crypto with a card or redeem gift cards. CoinGate holds a MiCA licence and a payment institution licence in Lithuania. The Lithuanian company has run since 2014, and beyond checkout it offers dedicated payment addresses for repeat customers, crypto payouts and a multi-currency business account.
content.meta: MiCA-licensed gateway for accepting crypto payments and settling in euros or stablecoins. Explore CoinGate on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
